name: Tapo C520WS (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11b/g/n) and a 10/100 Mbps Ethernet port.

matter.note: TP-Link's German page doesn't mention Matter, and we found no CSA listing. Not confirmed.

apple_home.note: TP-Link's page doesn't mention Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: TP-Link's page lists Google Assistant. Which features work in Google Home (live view on a display, for example) isn't spelled out.

alexa.note: TP-Link's page lists Amazon Alexa. Which features work (live view on an Echo Show, for example) isn't spelled out.

smartthings.note: No SmartThings mention on the pages we saw.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's built-in TP-Link Smart Home integration lists the C520WS among Tapo cameras. Live view needs a camera account set in the Tapo app; some firmware also needs third-party access turned on in Tapo Lab.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi or Ethernet; the page lists no hub or base station.

localControl.note: The page lists ONVIF and RTSP support and microSD recording; Home Assistant's integration polls locally.

cameraType.note: Pan/tilt camera rated IP66, 2K QHD (2560 x 1440).

power.note: The page says the camera doesn't support solar panels.

localStorage.note: microSD card up to 512 GB, sold separately.

subscription.value: Cloud clip history and snapshots (Tapo Care)
subscription.note: Tapo Care adds cloud storage (30 days of clips) with a one-month free trial; local recording needs no plan.

summary: Outdoors, the Tapo C520WS (EU) pans and tilts, records 2K QHD video and is rated IP66. It runs on a 9 V mains adapter and saves clips to a microSD card of up to 512 GB; the page lists ONVIF and RTSP. Alexa and Google Assistant are listed, and Home Assistant has a built-in integration. TP-Link's page doesn't mention Apple Home or Matter.
caveats: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; use the Ethernet port for a wired link.
Needs a 9 V mains adapter at the camera; solar isn't supported.
Cloud clip history and snapshots need Tapo Care after the free month; microSD recording doesn't.
Home Assistant live view needs a camera account from the Tapo app.
